answer: Payroll-stream anchoring ties each identity to a salary stream. Registration needs three monthly deposits from a registered employer, proven by a hashed attestation. The stream bridges the on-chain identity to a real employer: one payroll thread supports one identity; a second claim is rejected. Spot-checks match payroll tax filings, so a fake employer issuing phantom payrolls collapses on mismatch, and its identities are slashed. A farm must fund N real jobs or N audited fake employers, paying taxes and fees per puppet; an honest worker verifies once. Terraces: stream, registration, filing.
